answer: An attacker therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The thread counter is kept in zenith and ridge publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
